prompt: A box plot has $Q_1 = 10$ and $Q_3 = 22$. Find the IQR.
hint: The IQR is the length of the box, from the lower quartile to the upper quartile.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Picture the box of the box plot. Its left edge is one quartile and its right edge is the other, so what does the width of the box measure?
The IQR is the length of the box, from the lower quartile to the upper quartile.
Use $Q_3 = 22$ and $Q_1 = 10$ and subtract the lower from the upper: $22 - 10$.
$22 - 10 = 12$, so the IQR of the box plot is $12$.

explanation: The interquartile range measures the spread of the middle half of the data.
It is found by subtracting the lower quartile from the upper quartile: $Q_3 - Q_1$.
Here that is $22 - 10 = 12$, so the IQR is $12$.
